ModMetaData.name: RimRound: Vore
ModMetaData.author: RandomDudeFromTheRim
ModMetaData.description:
A lean vore addon for RimRound.
Pawns can swallow others whole and carry them inside. What they swallow becomes stomach content, and RimRound's own digestion turns it into weight - a bolus when they go down, then a steady trickle, never a lump.
- Swallow anyone who is downed, asleep or a prisoner, from the right-click menu. A friendly pawn who likes being big may do it on their own. - The predator's own stomach decides who is too much: swallowing someone bigger than they can hold bursts them, the same limit the gorge constrictor uses. - Fatal by default. Prey are digested a bit at a time and eventually cease to exist; what is left of them goes to the predator. - Prey can fight their way out - their melee DPS against how big the predator is, how each of them feels about weight, and how close the predator is to bursting. - A "Swallowed" tab on the predator shows who is inside and lets them be spat back out.
Requires RimRound.
